items.title: Fanny
items.note: A model taken from the game client, used here as a visual reference. Her cable weapon is stored flat and laid out to one side of the body. The little robot beside the body has a face screen that can show eight other expressions.

items.title: Layla
items.note: A model taken from the game client, used here as a visual reference. Her rifle is stored separate from the body and laid out to one side. The little robot beside the body has a face screen that can show eight other expressions.
